embedded_engine.product: LandValue360 Unified Monthly Deterministic Financial Kernel

platform.role: Advanced engine reference and full reporting platform

workflow: Portal saves one versioned monthly financial analysis model.
Administrators publish immutable financial policy versions containing return thresholds, negotiation positioning, timing, collection, cost, liquidity and financing assumptions.
Published user-selectable policy versions are available to standard users; every Calculation Run is permanently bound to the selected Policy Version.
Policy-managed advanced assumptions remain hidden from standard users while analysts and administrators retain controlled access.
Portal executes and persists an immutable Calculation Run with Project Version, Policy Version, Engine Version, Input Hash and Result Hash.
Portal produces separated project, developer and landowner results, residual land-value comparison, policy-positioned negotiation recommendation, PDF and Excel outputs.
Platform-native export carries the effective frozen financial assumptions used by the run.
Platform recalculates the project for advanced reports.
Contract Engine 3.1.0 applies Gross/Net/Profit shares only to their explicitly disclosed economic bases; Balanced and policy-adjusted ceilings remain distinct from the technical feasibility ceiling.
Negotiation visualization is anchored at the minimum acceptable consideration and uses collision-aware labels.
Each negotiation boundary is accompanied by a plain-language calculation rationale in the portal and PDF report.
The legacy analyst/status workspace is not exposed in the standalone portal user interface.
